description: This file contains core functionalities for handling upgrades within the SuiteCRM platform, including access control, file extraction, manifest handling, and utility functions related to upgrade types, images, localization, and validation.

methods.name: extractFile
methods.description: Extracts a specified file from a ZIP archive into a temporary directory and returns the path.

methods.name: extractManifest
methods.description: Extracts the manifest.php file from a ZIP archive using extractFile().

methods.name: getInstallType
methods.description: Determines the upgrade subdirectory type based on a string pattern.

methods.name: getImageForType
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon image URL for a given upgrade type.

methods.name: getLanguagePackName
methods.description: Retrieves the language pack name from a language file.

methods.name: getUITextForType
methods.description: Fetches the UI text label for a specific upgrade type.

methods.name: getUITextForMode
methods.description: Fetches the UI text label for a specific mode.

methods.name: validate_manifest
methods.description: Validates a manifest object using the PackageManager's validate_manifest method.

methods.name: getDiffFiles
methods.description: Compares files in an upgrade, identifying modified files based on MD5 checksums, considering whether it's an install or upgrade, and handling restore paths.
